scope: Twenty newly downloaded complete publisher PDFs. Six deep-reviewed papers and fourteen inventory-only papers are kept in separate quality denominators. This summary describes the unchanged installed 0.2.1 baseline with its original caption-number failures. The final frozen 0.2.2 repair is evaluated in separate evidence reports.

workflow.limitation: Workflow completion, readable exports and captured zero worker exits do not establish content accuracy or resolve the previously observed source-suite native diagnostic.

caption_association.policy: Only boolean true and the exact status 'correct' count as unqualified correct. Qualified/contaminated/partial statuses remain separate, not silently upgraded.
Only boolean true and the exact status 'correct' count as unqualified correct. Qualified/contaminated/partial statuses remain separate, not silently upgraded.

inventory_only.limitation: Inventory-only papers are not included in crop/cell quality denominators. Explicit spot-check issues remain visible in per-object source records.

numbered_inventory.limitation: Inventory coverage is broader than deep-quality coverage; these totals must not serve as the denominator for an all-object crop or cell accuracy percentage.

extra_resource_policy: Valid unnumbered notation tables lie outside the numbered-object denominator and are not false positives. Logos/page furniture, blank detections, equations and unreviewed extras retain separate classifications; no blanket scientific false-positive rate is inferred.

cumulative_source_coverage.limitation: Only source coverage is added across rounds. Different review depths and baseline versions are not combined into a universal extraction-accuracy percentage.

quality-ml.crop_policy: Full figure body includes printed panel labels/subcaptions within a composite figure; only the top-level caption may be stored separately. Diagram-only coverage is reported separately when panel explanations are omitted. Inventory-only crop_complete=null must not be counted as a pass.
quality-ml.scope: Six new complete PDFs, 96 pages. Only BART and LongT5 receive detailed output-crop/table-grid review and twenty predefined cells. The other four papers receive numbered-object inventory matching, with limited explicit spot checks; null crop fields mean not comprehensively reviewed.

quality-diverse.crop_complete: All scientific body content present; clean_separate_crop additionally excludes merged or oversized captures. A merged resource may cover two logical objects but remains defective.
quality-diverse.caption_association: Association, not perfect text fidelity. Mathematical Unicode/source-layer loss is reported separately.
quality-diverse.inventory_only: Numbered labels/pages compared to metadata; crop_complete and detailed cell accuracy are not graded.
quality-diverse.sample_cell_status: exact string at the semantic row/column in JSON+CSV+expandedHTML; numeric sign normalization is allowed only where preregistered.
quality-diverse.auxiliary: Logos, ORCID badges and page furniture are excluded from scientific counts.

quality-science.crop_complete: Deep review only: all scientific illustration panels/axes or table grid body visible across matched exports. Captions are assessed separately; exclusion of explanatory footnotes is explicitly noted. null means not reviewed at this level.
quality-science.correct_number: Every matched resource segment has the logical printed number; unnumbered fragments make this false.
quality-science.caption_association: correct/partial/missing refers to association, not exact fidelity of every mathematical glyph or unit.
quality-science.sample_cell_status: exact: expected string at explicitly mapped semantic row/column in JSON, CSV and expanded HTML grid; normalized: whitespace-only normalization; mismatch: content differs; ambiguous_missing: semantic row/column absent. Missing groups here are confirmed omissions, not merely unidentified tokens.
quality-science.auxiliary_logo: Publisher logos/CrossMark/footer marks are gallery noise, separately counted from fabricated scientific objects. Matched panel fragments are assigned to their true parent object and are not double-counted as extra resources.
quality-science.indices: Physical PDF pages and exported row/col indices are zero-based.
quality-science.scope_limit: Inventory match or format/HTTP success is not content accuracy. No new quantitative accuracy claim is made for unselected cells or five inventory-only papers. Baseline is 0.2.1; no 0.2.2 correction result is included.

papers.title: Python Battery Mathematical Modelling (PyBaMM)

objects.auto_caption: Figure 1 Models are encoded and passed down the pipeline using a symbolic expression tree data-structure. Leafs in the tree represent parameters, variables, matrices etc., while internal nodes represent either basic operators such multiplication or division, or continuous operators such as divergence or gradients.

These models are then passed to a class which sets the parameters of the model, before being discretised into linear algebra expressions, and finally solved using a time-stepping class.

issues.detail: PNG shows the complete table body with visible plus/minus signs. JSON/CSV/HTML instead form a 14 x 7 transposed grid: 8 measure/noise rows followed by 6 shredded method-label rows; header_rows=0. Requires manual restructuring before use.

Six selected plus/minus expressions render correctly in source and PNG but contain digit 6 in the independently extracted PDFium text and exported JSON/CSV/HTML, e.g. 3.5+/-0.7 becomes 3.560.7. This predates CSV/HTML serialization; no blind replacement was applied.
The source table footnote explaining injected noise and 100 runs is not included in the PNG grid or structured table export.
